contradictionsAndTensions.topic: Async preference vs synchronous public contracts

evidence.quote: Use TensorFlow.js for the core batched propagation. JavaScript loops are acceptable for parsing, ID mapping, formatting, and small fixtures; they must not replace the main propagation with per-edge loops. You may avoid the full square adjacency matrix by implementing its two off-diagonal blocks with `R` and `R^T`, vector degree normalization, and `tf.matMul`. Await `tf.ready()`, report `tf.getBackend()`, manage tensors with `tf.tidy()` and dispose long-lived tensors, read results asynchronously where practical, never put an async callback inside `tf.tidy()`, and make sure repeated runs do not accumulate tensors. Record runtime and backend without comparing timings across devices. PPR is an iterative calculation, not neural-network training; no optimizer is required. Write code, comments and JSDoc in English and document inputs, outputs, indexing, assumptions and failure cases.
